applicability: The current capsule budget record and its packaged copy.
conditions: Renewal sub-records are the decision keys that start with measuredCurrentRenewal.
exclusions: Older decision sub-records without that prefix (currentRenewal, currentRenewalValidation32, currentRenewalValidation35, rawBaselineSerializationCorrection624), which carry no historicalTree.
Paths written with a skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/ prefix, which the absent-path guard does not check.
